  Hypotheses checked and disproved:
  • The nudge text itself matches API_ERROR. It doesn't: API error. is followed by ., not : or a space.
  • The "alerted" stage loops. It doesn't: neither api branch fires, so no second nudge or restart.
  • The template restart loops. It doesn't: rec["template"] is kept across the restart and the cooldown, and restart.sh does not copy herdr.template, so the new Assistant is relabelled at first
  sight.
  • A restart where restart.sh fails (no space or tab) alerts. It doesn't: the old_tpl branch never alerts and records the template, so there is no retry.
  • Template path mismatch. template_info() reads ~/.config/herdr-core/templates/assistant.md, which is the same path mods/coordinator/restart.sh uses.
